describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile, low to the ground on four short limbs. It has a broad, flat, pale gray-blue head with a blunt snout, large round eyes, and a slightly upturned mouth, giving an axolotl-like appearance. Six pink, feathery external gills protrude from the sides of the head and upper neck, three per side. The entire dorsal surface from just behind the gills over the arched back and along the full length of the long, tapering tail is covered in overlapping, dark brown to tan, keratinous scales arranged in diagonal rows. The ventral and lateral skin of the head, neck, belly, and limbs is pale, smooth to wrinkled, and lighter in color, with a segmented, ridged belly visible between the fore and hind limbs. The four limbs are thick and stout, ending in clawed feet, and the animal casts a soft shadow on a plain off-white background.
